answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable identity bond before it can wander the market and transact. A sybil swarm spun up like a falcon strike must post one bond per fake identity, and any flagged collusion slashes every linked deposit at once, so forged influence costs real capital that scales linearly with the swarm. An honest agent, marked by the umber patina of a long bond history, simply recovers its stake. Fakery stops being free.
